question: Whose autobiography is ‘Playing it my way’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Playing It My Way is the autobiography of Former Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar.
 
• It was co-authored by Boria Majumdar, an Indian sports journalist along with Sachin.
 
• The autobiography was published on 5 November 2014.
 
• The book describes the early days of the cricketer, his 24 years of career, and his different aspects of life.
 
• Here, he talks about his cricket journey from his first Test match to his 100th international century and his farewell in this field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sachin Tendulkar was born on 24 April 1973 and started his cricket journey at the age of 16.
 
• He was awarded Bharat Ratna Award on the day of his retirement.
 
• A Century Is Not Enough is an autobiography of Sourav Ganguly.
 
• Yuvraj Singh is associated with The Test of My Life.
 
• The biography of Rahul Dravid, The Nice Guy Who Finished First was written by Devendra Prabhudesai.
